messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Incident was on March 3 (2025-03-03); agent filed incident_date 2025-03-13, a date different from the stated date.", "verifier": {"reason": "Executed tool arguments must match the details the user explicitly confirmed (policy: \"- Before `file_claim` and `approve_payout`, summarize the details (including amounts) and get explicit confirmation (\"yes\"/\"да\").\") — The call `file_claim` executes incident_date=\"2025-03-13\", which differs from the value the user confirmed: the proposal h30 states \"дата происшествия 3 марта 2025 года\" and the user replied h31: \"Да, подавайте.\"."}}
